headline: Peru Economy Minister Expects State Oil Firm Petro-Perú to Return to Profitability
summary: Peru's Minister of Economy and Finance Elmer Cuba highlighted early operational recovery milestones, predicting state-owned energy company Petro-Perú will generate net income gains this year.
why: Petro-Perú is Peru's state hydrocarbon enterprise; its financial solvency directly impacts national public fiscal accounts.

impacts.name: Petro-Perú
impacts.why: A return to annual profitability reduces sovereign credit bailout risk.
